The '''BDY crew skiff''' was a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] manufactured by [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]] capable of travel in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The BDY skiff, also classed as a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], was capable of holding at least twenty-four beings. At least three BDY skiffs were [[Pirate/Legends|pirated]] by [[44 ABY]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. The skiffs were carried in an [[S18 light freighter]] and used in the [[Skirmish near Ashteri's Cloud|ambush]] of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] ''[[Rockhound]]''.
